public_body: Groton Working Group On Studying Pilots
overall: The AG found the Town Manager's PILOT working group fell within the Connelly exception as an advisory group to him, so it is not a public body and the Open Meeting Law did not apply; no violation found.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Groton PILOT working group failed to post notice of its meetings as the Open Meeting Law requires.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Group is not a public body, and therefore not subject to the Open Meeting Law and did not violate the Law in the ways alleged.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the working group did not allow members of the public to attend its meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Group falls within the Connelly exception and is not a public body.
